records.source: 古来より伝わる遠国の賢者の{j}伝承を元に作成された鎚。{j}持ち主に風の力を宿すという。
records.previous: A Hammer forged from the{j}legend of a sage from a distant land, handed down since ancient times.{j}It is said to imbue its wielder with the power of wind.
records.target: Hammer from a sage's legend.{j}Passed down for ages, it is said{j}to grant its wielder wind power.

records.target: Sword & Shield from a knight's legend.{j}Passed down since ancient times, it{j}once ruled the world.

records.source: 帝征龍の魂が宿る剣斧。所持{j}者の力を高みへと導き、抗え{j}ぬ程の力で相手を蹂躙する。
records.previous: A Switch Axe inhabited by the soul of the Emperor Dragon. It guides the power of its wielder{j}to new heights, and overwhelms the opponent with an irresistible{j}force.
records.target: Switch Axe bearing an Emperor Dragon soul.{j}It guides its wielder to new heights,{j}overwhelming foes with irresistible force.

records.source: 蒼火竜と桜火竜の甲殻を用いた{j}剣斧。二対の火竜を制した証で{j}あり、その証たる力を秘める。
records.previous: {j}A Switch Axe made from the shells of the Azure Rathalos and Pink Rathalos. It is{j}proof of having conquered two pairs of fire wyverns and holds power worthy of that proof.
records.target: {j}Switch Axe from Azure and Pink Rathalos.{j}Proof of conquering two fire-wyvern pairs.

records.source: 古の装飾が施された黒い太刀。{j}儀礼用であったものを鍛え、{j}至高の逸品へと昇華した。
records.previous: A black Long Sword adorned with ancient ornamentation.{j}Forged from what was once ceremonial,{j}it was elevated into a supreme masterpiece.
records.target: Black Long Sword with ancient ornament.{j}Forged from a ceremonial weapon into{j}a supreme masterpiece.
